d:
Mohun Bagan lost their MG ISL 2026-27 opener, then won five straight to go top. Watch all 10 goals so far, in match order, from the comeback against SC Delhi to the win at Fatorda.
Next up is the Derby against East Bengal on 29 November.
After a 0-1 defeat against NorthEast United FC on 12 October, the Mariners switched gears and came from behind against SC Delhi and Punjab FC, edged Chennaiyin FC late, won a thriller against Odisha FC, and beat Churchill Brothers SC on 22 November to reach 15 points.
